\[
A \circledast (B_1, B_2) = (A \ominus B_1) \cap (A^c \ominus B_2)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(A\): The foreground
- \(B_1, B_2\): The pattern pixels that must be foreground and background

B_1 holds the pattern pixels that must be foreground and B_2 those that must be background. A pixel is marked when B_1 fits inside the foreground and B_2 inside the background, both placed at that pixel. Pixels marked 0 in the pattern may be either. Values other than 1, -1 and 0 make the filter use the default pattern.
